testcase.name: Scenario: Add and switch between browser panel tabs: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:253:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Add and switch between browser panel tabs ✔ Given a drawing is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its Model browser is docked on the left ✔ And an additional log panel is available in the browser's plus menu ✔ When the user adds the log panel from the plus menu ✔ Then the log panel becomes active in the same dock ✔ And the Model browser remains available as a tab ✔ When the user selects the Model browser tab ✔ Then the drawing resources and sheet tree are displayed ✔ When the user selects the log panel tab ✔ Then the log area is displayed in the dock ✔ When the user closes the log panel tab ✔ Then the Model browser is displayed ✔ And the drawing remains visible
